arcSummary: Ondrej was seconded to the guild when his school united behind its archmage. A man entered in two ledgers is owned by neither, or both. He would like the accounts settled.

stages.title: The Ledger Entry
stages.summary: He lays his secondment papers on the table with a bookkeeper's care and one unbookkeeperly question.

stages.title: Due Diligence
stages.summary: A working in the field is miscast and cascading. Doctrine says withdraw and document. The guild is standing inside it.

stages.title: The Revision
stages.summary: He has drafted a petition to Master Pendry: revise the secondment. He wants it witnessed.
